body:
gen1 main collapsed permanently to a zero-variance no-buttons policy -- SB3's PPO defaults ent_coef=0.0, no protection against log_std drifting to near-zero variance (and once very negative, the recovery gradient is itself nearly flat, so it never un-collapses). Added --ent-coef flag (default 0.01), wired into _fresh_model/_load_resumed_model_or_fresh and all 3 call sites in main(). Test assertion updated for new kwarg, 34/34 pass. Commit 055beb8.

⚓ ☃
title: S456: wire ent_coef through argparse and all call sites to fix PPO policy collapse
